# handlebars-go

> Handlebars templates in pure Go (github.com/ofershap/handlebars-go),
> differentially tested against handlebars.js 4.7.8: 71 golden fixtures
> compare byte-for-byte. All nine documented option flags (strict, noEscape,
> compat, knownHelpers, knownHelpersOnly, assumeObjects, preventIndent,
> stringParams, trackIds), helperMissing/blockHelperMissing, raw blocks,
> partials, subexpressions, block params. Standard library only, no
> dependencies.

## Usage

- out, err := handlebars.Render(templateSource, data, nil); handlebars.MustRender panics on error; Parse once and Execute many for hot paths.
- Typed TemplateError names line and column and quotes the offending text - built for agent pipelines.
- Named dialect difference: Go maps iterate sorted keys (handlebars.js preserves insertion order); use slices for ordered output.
- Escaping matches handlebars.js exactly; SafeString and triple-stash bypass by design.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ofershap/handlebars-go#readme): install, option matrix, fixture coverage, security notes, Q&A
- [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/ofershap/handlebars-go): library API
